name: LAMINAR AIR FLOW (HORIZONTAL)
desc: Designed to provide a continuous, uniform stream of ultra-clean filtered air across a minimum 4ft workspace, achieving a strict Class 100 cleanliness level. Equipped with dual-stage filtration (10-micron Pre-filter and 0.3-micron HEPA filter).
features: High-intensity Germicidal UV Lamp for automated surface disinfection
Dynamically balanced blower unit for uniform air velocity
Heavy-Duty Enclosure with high-grade Stainless Steel work surface

specifications.Airflow Configuration: Horizontal Unidirectional Stream (Laminar Flow UV Chamber layout)
specifications.Working Area Dimensions: Minimum 4ft (Width) x 2ft (Height) x 2ft (Depth) spacious work zone
specifications.Primary Filtration Stage: Washable Pre-filter efficient in removing dust particles above 10-micron size
specifications.Secondary Filtration Stage: High-Efficiency HEPA Filter removing 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 micron size
specifications.Airflow Performance: Dynamically balanced blower unit ensuring a smooth and uniform air velocity
specifications.Material of Construction: Heavy-Duty Enclosure with high-grade Stainless Steel work surface
specifications.Front Sash / Door: Clear view protective screen for easy access and process visibility
specifications.Sterilization System: High-intensity Germicidal UV Lamp integrated for automated surface disinfection
specifications.Chamber Illumination: In-built glare-free lighting system for precision analysis activities
specifications.Control Interface: User-friendly electronic switches for Blower, LED Light, and UV Lamp operation
specifications.Document Submission: Agreed to furnish all signed TP documents and test reports to buyer on demand
